verdict.rationale: MoonPay documents a public Developer Platform API defined by an OpenAPI 3.1 spec, with concrete endpoints for sessions and quotes, a Customer API for submitting KYC, and guidance on calling the Platform API server-side with a customer's access token. Payment capture and verification still run through MoonPay-hosted frames, and the probe found no spec at the standard OpenAPI paths, though that does not contradict the docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API end-to-end, a spec reachable at a standard OpenAPI location, and fully API-only execution of card capture and verification without hosted frames.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The MoonPay Developer Platform API is defined using an OpenAPI 3.1 specification. You can use this spec to generate typed clients for any language.
